# CFI Academy

> > CFI Academy specializes in accelerated flight instructor certification training (CFI, CFII, MEI) with a near-perfect success rate and pathways to professional pilot careers.

CFI Academy offers comprehensive instructor-focused flight training programs based in Lodi, California, including accelerated certification courses, college degree partnerships, and professional pilot pathways. The academy combines rigorous training doctrine exceeding FAA standards with flexible financing options and career development support.

## Key Topics

- CFI (Certified Flight Instructor)
- CFII (Flight Instructor Instrument)
- MEI (Multi Engine Instructor)
- Professional Pilot Program
- Fundamentals of Instruction (FOI)
- Accelerated Flight Training
- Flight Instructor Certification
- MOSAIC Sport Pilot
- Teaching Skills
- Instructor Development
- Flight Training Financing
- CFI Academy Lodi
- Checkride Preparation
- Pilot Education
- Instructor Training

## Core Certification Programs

- [CFI | Certificated Flight Instructor](https://www.cfiacademy.com/courses/cfi-certified-flight-instructor-training): CFI certification course with 3-week accelerated option
- [CFII | Flight Instructor Instrument](https://www.cfiacademy.com/courses/cfii): CFII add-on course in 3 days with checkride on day 4
- [MEI | Multi Engine Instructor](https://www.cfiacademy.com/courses/mei): MEI add-on course in 3 days using Beech Duchess aircraft

## Professional Pilot Programs

- [Professional Pilot Program](https://www.cfiacademy.com/courses/professional-pilot-program): Accelerated Professional Pilot Program completion in 6-8 months
- [Professional Pilot Program with CFI Certification](https://www.cfiacademy.com/courses/professional-pilot-program/professional-pilot-program-with-cfi-certification): Professional Pilot Program with CFI certification in 6-8 months
- [Professional Pilot Program (Non-CFI Path)](https://www.cfiacademy.com/courses/professional-pilot-program/professional-pilot-program-multi-engine-non-cfi): Professional Pilot Program non-CFI multi-engine path in 6-8 months
- [Commercial Pilot Plus CFI Combination](https://www.cfiacademy.com/courses/commercial-pilot-cfi-combination): Commercial pilot and CFI combination course in 3 weeks

## Accelerated Training & Specialized Programs

- [Accelerated Flight Training](https://www.cfiacademy.com/accelerated-flight-training): Accelerated flight training with nearly 100% success rate
- [College Degree Program](https://www.cfiacademy.com/college-degree-program): CFI Academy and UVU college degree program for flight instructors
- [Private Pilot Training](https://www.cfiacademy.com/private-pilot-training): Private pilot certification training by certified flight instructors
- [Sport Pilot Training Under MOSAIC](https://www.cfiacademy.com/sport-pilot-training-mosaic): Sport Pilot training under MOSAIC rules at Lodi location

- [Training Doctrine & Evaluation Standards](https://www.cfiacademy.com/training-doctrine): CFI Academy training doctrine and evaluation standards exceeding FAA
